propositions: Five tests have vacuous assertions that cannot fail due to missing constructor arguments, incomplete AST walks, boolean presence checks instead of return-value contracts, overpermissive inequality comparisons, or mislabeled class-relationship assertions rather than behavioral tests.

test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport constructs a transport that never receives a PAT and asserts against a string in a default object repr, making the assertion tautological regardless of whether the transport leaks credentials.

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST predicate inline instead of calling the shared helper _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default, preventing mutation of the predicate from causing test failure.

test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username asserts only hasattr(cls, 'validate_assignee_exists') without verifying the return value is a username string rather than a bool or accountId-shaped value.
The rate-limit retry sweep asserts total <= 1 per member instead of total == 1, allowing zero client calls (pre-flight exceptions) to satisfy the constraint and never reach the 429 code path.
test_an_unknown_backend_raises_the_registry_error_not_key_error never calls select_backend and asserts only a class relationship, not the raising behavior the name promises.
